name: devcorner
description: Connects Claude Code to devcorner, which you sign in to from /mcp: opens and closes a devcorner session with each conversation, registers each subagent as a child session, and puts new messages in front of the model while it works, one line each, asking devcorner only when something waits. When something wakes a waiting session, such as your answer from devcorner, the end of a run it asked for or its pull request's conflict, an idle conversation starts a turn for it, naming what came, once and only while it is unread. /devcorner:cloud-agent sets up your Claude Code routine for cloud runs in one step. A quiet line above the prompt, drawn by devcorner itself with no warning sign, says what waits on you and how the repo's overnight night stands; its more opens it to the project's picture (Project home, Active actions and In flight first, then the workspace and project, this conversation's session and ticket, what waits first, the night, the work in flight and cloud sessions, Next's first three and the code against the last deploy), each part a link to its page in devcorner, and less closes it; the held request names a 25 s hold; a repo new to devcorner gets a one-line offer to set it up; for the minute after a deploy of devcorner the line says devcorner is updating, and the plugin waits as long as devcorner asked before it asks again; /dc shows the same picture as text or asks devcorner something. The hooks need a hook token in DEVCORNER_TOKEN; with none, as in a cloud session, the plugin writes the Claude account's capacity to a file when a reading is due, which the session passes to devcorner on a call it makes anyway.
